description: This file defines the JsonBody class, which models a JSON body in the mockserver framework, including methods for creating JSON bodies, parsing JSON fields, and handling content types and serialization.

classes.name: JsonBody
classes.description: Represents a JSON body with content type, match type, and JSON parsing capabilities within the mockserver framework.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Factory methods for creating JsonBody instances from JSON strings or objects with optional match type, charset, and content type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific JSON field as a JsonNode.

methods.name: getRawBytes
methods.description: Returns the raw byte array of the JSON content.

methods.name: getMatchType
methods.description: Returns the match type used for this JSON body.
